decision.record: Decided 2026-11-04. The identifier is the project-controlled GitHub namespace in reverse DNS and is also the HarmonyOS bundle spelling, which forbids hyphens. Minimums: Windows 10.0.17763, macOS 11.0 (the aarch64-apple-darwin rustc floor), Linux glibc 2.31, HarmonyOS 5.1.0(18) (the API 18 SDK installed on this machine; API 20 / 6.0.0 is the other installed SDK). The first release is a directory, not a single file, because the interface catalogue under language/ is runtime data read from disk: a .dmg, a portable .zip, a .tar.gz and a .hap. Signing material is never recorded here; each release machine configures its own signing identity. The Linux installed icon basename follows the application id, so Icon= in the desktop entry resolves.
